goals: Make Frost Protection I or higher on any single equipped armor slot grant the player leather-boots-equivalent immunity to powdered-snow traversal effects.
Change the Blessing of Demeter crafted book, without changing its existing recipe, to contain only Frost Protection III by removing the existing Frost Walker II and Frost Protection II enchantments.

Preserve Frost Protection behavior outside the requested powdered-snow traversal change and preserve unrelated Matcha Flavoured content unless implementation investigation establishes a necessary compatibility adjustment.
scope: Inspect the exact current Matcha Flavoured Minecraft Java 26.2 enchantment, recipe, and data implementation before selecting an implementation approach.
Implement the narrowest future change that treats Frost Protection I or higher on the helmet, chestplate, leggings, or boots as sufficient for the targeted powdered-snow traversal behavior.

Change only the enchantments produced by the existing Blessing of Demeter recipe so its resulting book contains exactly Frost Protection III, with the existing Frost Walker II and Frost Protection II enchantments absent and no unintended additional enchantments.
Verify representative client, save/reload, and multiplayer or dedicated-server behavior when relevant to the eventual implementation.

exclusions: Implementation source, build files, generated output, artifacts, and Canary versions while this project remains PLANNED.
Replacement of Matcha Flavoured's enchantment system or broad changes beyond the narrow behavior and result edits in this project.
Global changes to Frost Walker or changes to ordinary Frost Walker behavior.
Changes to the Blessing of Demeter recipe ingredients, recipe shape, or crafting method.
Changes to unrelated Matcha Flavoured enchantments, recipes, items, mechanics, projects, or resource packs.
Changes to Frost Protection's existing behavior outside the requested powdered-snow traversal behavior unless implementation evidence demonstrates that a compatibility adjustment is necessary.
Modification of originals, either Minecraft instance, runtime deployment state, or runtime validation during project initialization.

dependencies.reason: Exact target game version whose powdered-snow and enchantment behavior the future implementation must preserve and extend narrowly.
Target loader for any future code-level compatibility change; the exact implementation dependency must be established during investigation.
